column1: # Rows: kind <TAB> path-regex <TAB> line-regex (empty = the whole file) <TAB> reason. `#` starts a comment line.
# `key` is the one row that owns the ticket-key pattern for himmel repo text (word boundaries written out,
# awk ERE has no \b). Every other row exempts the lines it matches from the key refusal and, when the
# line-regex is empty, from every refusal of the gate.
# Kinds: K1 history record, K2 fixture, K3 mirror copy, K4 provenance or generated, K6 data value a program
# reads, K7 this list. A test file key that is not a comment or a citation is test data and needs no row.
# CI judges a pull request with the BASE copy of this list, so a new row lands in its own change first.
